policy: The compositional parser owns new language behavior. Exact and regex constructions are compatibility candidates only and may not bypass typed planning, validation, execution, or evidence checks.

components.purpose: Span-preserving semantic interpretation and typed-plan compilation
Preserve deterministic DV7-DV13 behavior while coverage migrates
components.removalCriteria: Remove each construction only after an equivalent compositional parse has deterministic regression coverage and no DV7-DV14 regression.

components.purpose: Answer-noun compatibility used by the compositional parser
components.removalCriteria: Move into a typed lexicon after relation-domain coverage and sense tests replace its phrase inventory.

forbidden: A regex route that directly realizes factual text
A compatibility fallback after a complete, typed, subject-compatible plan
Treating generated construction totals as measured answer capability
